item.title: SHEET 5 — REFERENCE ARCHITECTURE
item.description: The primary RP9 presentation is intentionally restricted to the direct methodological, structural, computational, and declarative material required for formal examination.Its function is to present the established operations, resulting structures, verification procedures, and declared conclusions as precisely and directly as possible.For this reason, the primary presentation does not attempt to include every pedagogical explanation, alternative visualization, extended relational interpretation, terminology reference, review aid, or supplementary presentation format contained within the RP9 repository.These materials are preserved separately within:B. EQUILIBRIUM APPENDIXES The Equilibrium Appendixes constitute the supporting reference architecture of the RP9 repository.A proof-oriented presentation and a pedagogical explanation do not perform the same function.The primary presentation is designed to establish: what is derived; what is structurally produced; what is computationally reproduced; what is verified; and what is formally declared. The appendix layer is designed to explain: how the established relations may be interpreted; how individual structural stages are connected; how terminology is used; how the repository may be reviewed; and where additional visual, relational, technical, and pedagogical material can be found. These two layers are therefore intentionally separated.PRIMARY PRESENTATION ↓ Direct function, derivation, verification, and result EQUILIBRIUM APPENDIXES ↓ Interpretation, explanation, orientation, and supporting reference The separation prevents pedagogical expansion from being confused with the evidential sequence itself.It also allows the primary presentation to remain concise without removing the broader explanatory material required for complete understanding.The supporting reference material is located within:RP9. EQUILIBRIUM APPENDIXES.The review relation is therefore:Primary Presentation ↓ Established function or result ↓ Need for additional context ↓ B. EQUILIBRIUM APPENDIXES ↓ Relational, pedagogical, visual, or technical explanation The appendix layer provides the context needed to understand how an established result belongs to the wider RP9 framework without altering the result or becoming part of its primary evidential derivation.The Reference Architecture is based on a strict distinction: Evidence establishes the result. Explanation establishes the context through which the result may be more fully understood.
